uncertainties: Concurrent start requests may produce identical queue_position values; recommend DB-side atomic allocation.
Race window between DB set to 'running' and PID file write can leave orphaned 'running' jobs if spawn fails (add rollback or atomic write).
Some UI job creation/import flows produce slightly different job_config shapes; confirm canonical creation path for automation.
Multi-cron worker deployments have potential for double-claiming queued jobs — current code assumes a single cron worker; consider DB conditional update/transaction to claim jobs atomically.
